pulse: NQ futures ~+2% premarket (Nasdaq-100 +2.15% per Reuters) on Anthropic's record $83 IPO debut lifting AI/semis (GOOGL, AMD, AVGO, MU bid); offsets are the NVDA leadership overhang, new US chip curbs halting some Samsung/TSMC China shipments, and Hormuz tanker mine strikes keeping Brent ~$92.
bias: risk-on — ANT debut euphoria and a semis bid drive the gap up after five red S&P days, but Wednesday's NVDA pop faded into the close and Hormuz/Crimea headlines can cap it
items: @DeItaone (~7:13 AM ET): $ANT Anthropic IPO set to open on Nasdaq ~10:00 AM ET (quotation 9:50), priced $83 above the $70-78 range; gray market indicated +22-26% (@unusual_whales 6:17 AM) — Bullish NQ
@WatcherGuru (~5:43 AM ET): Samsung and TSMC suspend some chip shipments to China after new US restrictions — Bearish NQ
X News (~7:28 AM ET): IRGC says supertankers carrying 4M+ bbl hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz; Brent ~$92.2, WTI ~$83.2 (@DepartmentofOil 7:05 AM) — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~7:05 AM ET): WMT Q3 adj EPS 65c vs 64c est, rev $188.84B vs $187.17B, FY adj EPS raised to $2.84-2.89; WMT ~-0.7% pre — Mixed NQ
@LiveSquawk (~7:08 AM ET): Alibaba CEO: AI product revenue run-rate >$10B; BABA rev beat, adj EPS miss, cloud +53%, ~+2.6% pre — Mixed NQ
trump: Trump, Xi and Putin held the first-ever trilateral at APEC in Shenzhen (@WhiteHouse 12:29 AM ET); Putin: 'I have no doubt that Trump is genuinely committed to resolving the Ukrainian conflict' (6:57 AM ET), but vowed 'much more painful' retaliation for the Crimean bridge strike (7:17 AM ET). Trump on Fox warned Iran over unconventional (gas/biological) threats and called the prior Iran MOU 'a waste of time'.
watch: 8:30 AM ET weekly jobless claims + Philly Fed; 9:50-10:00 AM ET ANT first trade (AI valuation test, watch NQ hold the gap); INTU AMC tonight; Hormuz/oil and Russia-Ukraine retaliation headlines; Tue Nov 24 DELL and HPQ AMC.
